source: https://www.evisa.gov.ge/GeoVisa/en/VisaApp and https://www.evisa.gov.ge/GeoVisa/en/Home/FAQ, read 2026-08-30. The public first screen and FAQ identify the choices, documents and timing below. Later personal-information HTML validation attributes, regexes, character limits and field error text were not readable, so no pattern or length is claimed.

visa_free_status.label: Visa-free status
visa_free_status.help: The current government ordinance lists passports whose citizens may enter and stay without a visa for one full year. Check this before opening a paid application.

errors.required: Check whether this passport needs a visa before paying

citizenship.label: Citizenship / country
citizenship.placeholder: As shown in the travel document
citizenship.help: The first application screen says to select citizenship according to the passport that will be used for travel.

travel_document_type.label: Type of travel document / passport
travel_document_type.placeholder: Select the document you will carry
travel_document_type.help: Eligibility depends on holding one of the travel documents listed after the citizenship choice.

purpose_of_visit.label: Purpose of visit
purpose_of_visit.help: The e-Visa portal is for short-stay visits of less than 90 days and asks for proof of the selected purpose.

passport_validity.label: Passport validity
passport_validity.help: The passport must remain valid for at least 3 months after the requested Georgian visa expires, have at least 2 free pages and have been issued within the previous 10 years.

errors.required: Confirm the passport meets the published conditions

photo.label: Recent photo
photo.help: The FAQ requires a recent photo facing the camera and rejects snapshots, mobile-device photos and scans copied from other official documents.

errors.required: A compliant recent photo is required

supporting_documents.label: Supporting documents
supporting_documents.placeholder: Passport PDF, accommodation, ticket, insurance and funds
supporting_documents.help: The application lists a passport scan, accommodation, round ticket, travel insurance, financial means and travel-purpose evidence. A supporting-document copy is included when applicable.

errors.required: Prepare the documents listed by the portal

email_verification.label: Email address
email_verification.placeholder: An inbox you can open immediately
email_verification.help: The FAQ says the first verification email expires after 1 hour. Payment must then be completed within 5 hours of the payment notice.

errors.required: An accessible email address is required

duverify.label: DuVerify follow-up
duverify.help: The live application states that DuVerify is the second mandatory step and carries an additional USD 15 fee per applicant.
